Conference · Panel

SHIELD Lab co-organized and presented a clean-energy innovation panel

SHIELD Lab co-organized and presented a panel on digital engineering, AI and cybersecurity at the Illinois Innovation Network Conference 2026.

Illinois Innovation Network Conference 2026: Powering Illinois’ Future Together · October 2026 · Southern Illinois University Edwardsville.

Session: Accelerating Clean Energy Innovation through Digital Engineering, AI, and Cybersecurity. Location: Health Sciences 1330.

Moderator: Todd Rusk, Associate Director, University of Illinois EnergySense Resilience Center.

SIUC panelists: Md Amzad Hossain; Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid; Md Zahidul Islam; Additya Barua; Syed Mhamudul Hasan; Md Sayed Hasan Rifat.

Conference presentation · EMNLP

Soumik presented Edits in the Wild in Budapest

Mohd. Farhan Israk Soumik presented the Edits in the Wild poster at EMNLP 2026 in Budapest, Hungary.

Read the paper ↗

Oct 2026
Research resources · ACCESS Explore

ACCESS Explore supports federated vision–language model research

SHIELD Lab received ACCESS Explore resource support for research on privacy-induced cross-modal representation degradation in federated vision–language models.

Understanding and Mitigating Privacy-Induced Cross-Modal Representation Degradation in Federated Vision-Language Models. The active allocation runs October 2026–October 2027.

Oct 2026
Grant awarded · Upcoming workshop

NSF ACCESS Regional AI Workshop grant awarded to SHIELD Lab

The awarded grant will support Advancing AI Research, Education, and Workforce Development in Southern Illinois and the Midwest, a one-day hybrid workshop planned for September 2027 at Southern Illinois University Carbondale.

Official ACCESS Regional AI Workshops listing ↗

The upcoming workshop will bring together regional audiences around AI education, interdisciplinary AI research and workforce development.

The planned program includes ACCESS and NAIRR resources, AI+ degree pathways, hands-on GPU labs and responsible AI.

Oct 2026
Research grant · NAIRR

NAIRR grant supports trustworthy consumer generative AI research

SHIELD Lab received a NAIRR Start-Up grant for ConsumerGenEdit: A Multilingual Benchmark for On-Device Generative Image Editing in Cybersecurity and Trustworthy Multimodal AI.

The support includes 2,000 GPU hours on Purdue Anvil AI for the period October 2026–January 2027. Dr. Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid is principal investigator.

Dr. Shahid co-chaired two ICMLA 2026 special sessions

Dr. Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid served as co-chair of two special sessions, “Multimodal Machine Learning in Practice” and “Graph Machine Learning for Complex Systems and Applications,” at the International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026).

Multimodal Machine Learning in Practice ↗Graph Machine Learning for Complex Systems and Applications ↗

Conference presentation · ACL Industry

Soumik presented No Innocence in Styling at ACL 2026 ↗

Mohd. Farhan Israk Soumik presented No Innocence in Styling at ACL 2026 in San Diego, sharing research on privacy protection and security risks in consumer generative AI writing assistants.

Jul 2026
Education grant · NAIRR

NAIRR Classroom grant supports hands-on AI safety education

SHIELD Lab received a NAIRR Classroom grant for Hands-on AI Safety and Security Education for the AI Workforce Using Classroom-Scale LLM Resources.

The grant provides Prototype National Research Platform (PNRP) Classroom resources for 25 students, supporting hands-on AI safety and security education.

Dr. Abdur Rahman Bin Shahid is principal investigator. The resource allocation period is June–December 2026; the grant announcement is dated July 2026.

Award & conference participation · CVPR

Congratulations to Malithi on her CVPR 2026 scholarship

Malithi received the CVPR 2026 Broadening Participation Scholarship Award and attended CVPR in Denver, where her sensor–text alignment research was part of the Sense of Space workshop.

Workshop website ↗CVPR workshop paper ↗

Breaking Sensor-Text Alignment: Cross-Modal Attack on Contrastive Multimodal Human Activity Recognition investigates attacks on contrastive multimodal activity recognition.

The Sense of Space workshop took place in June 2026. This work is a CVPR workshop contribution.
